title: AT&T post-call 'Interested' recap SMS
goal: After a live power-dialer call where the caller dispositions a commercial lead as INTERESTED, send exactly ONE follow-up recap text from the registered number with the current AT&T promos. Consent boundary = the human conversation that just happened; never fires on cold/uncalled contacts.

deployment.dialer: Wavv power dialer (human on every call)
deployment.status: draft — NOT published. Trigger must be added in the GHL UI (see triggerSetup), then publish.

triggerSetup.note: The connector can write workflow ACTIONS but does NOT persist workflow TRIGGERS (PUT is accepted but triggers stay empty). Add the trigger manually in the GHL UI.
uiSteps: Open the workflow: Automation > Post-Call — Follow-up Text.
Set: tag IS 'wavv-interested' (the tag the Wavv dialer applies on the Interested disposition).
Optional: restrict to a re-entry window so a contact dispositioned Interested twice doesn't get double-texted.

compliance.audience: Commercial leads the team just spoke to live and marked Interested. The call is the consent boundary.
compliance.exclude: Never wire this to a cold tag, an upload tag, or a stage move that isn't a live-call Interested disposition. Map/scraped numbers are call/door only — this fires AFTER the call, not before.
compliance.sender: One A2P-registered number. No sender rotation / snowshoeing.
compliance.optOut: GHL auto-appends the opt-out line. Do not add or strip STOP. Honor STOP via the existing STOP workflow.
compliance.frequency: Single text only (Wait 10 min -> one SMS). Longer nurture is the separate 'Fiber + Phone Promo Drip' workflow.
compliance.a2p: A2P 10DLC on Command is UNCONFIRMED (bundleSid: null as of last check). Verify the Trust Center shows Approved before turning this live, or carriers will filter outbound.
compliance.tcpa: Texting non-consented/DNC = $500-$1,500 per message. Interested-disposition only.

steps.description: Wait 10 minutes after the Interested disposition so the caller can finish wrapping up the call.
Send the single recap text with the current promos. GHL appends the opt-out line.

attributes.body: Hi {{contact.first_name}}, Patrick w/ AT&T — great talking today! Recap: AT&T Fiber 1 Gig in the $40s, free install, no contract + a $500 Visa reward card. On wireless, add a line from $15/mo & iPhone 17 as low as $4/mo w/ trade-in. Want me to check what you qualify for? Reply YES or call 832-247-4060.

promos.fiber: AT&T Fiber 1 Gig in the $40s, free install, no contract, + $500 Visa reward card
promos.device: iPhone 17 as low as $4/mo with trade-in

replyRouting.yes: Continue booking; hand live calls to 832-247-4060; move opp forward and tag accordingly.
replyRouting.stop: Existing STOP workflow scrubs the contact; never re-text.
replyRouting.noReply: Stop texting; the lead stays in the call/dialer cadence.

confirmationPoints: Confirm A2P 10DLC is Approved before publishing.
Confirm the trigger is the live-call Interested disposition tag, not a cold/upload tag.
Publish only after the trigger is attached in the UI.
output: A single recap SMS to each lead marked Interested on a live call, sent from the registered number 10 minutes after disposition, with replies routed to booking.
